questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.
options: Only after the rain stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain stopped did they begin cleaning the garden.
Only after the rain stopped they began to clean the garden.
Only after the rain stopped they began cleaning the garden.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did they begin to clean the garden.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail?
options: It was John who broke the window yesterday morning.
It was John that broke the window yesterday morning.
It was John which broke the window yesterday morning.
It was John when he broke the window yesterday morning.
questions.answer: It was John who broke the window yesterday morning.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation.
options: If I were you, I would accept the job immediately.
If I was you, I would accept the job immediately.
If I had been you, I would accept the job immediately.
If I were being you, I would accept the job immediately.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the job immediately.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly utilizes ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?
options: She is taller than her sister, but she is fitter than her.
She is taller than her sister, but she is fitter than her.
She is taller than her sister, but she is fitter than her sister.
She is taller than her sister, but she is fitter than her sister.
questions.answer: She is taller than her sister, but she is fitter than her.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly employs a complex sentence structure with multiple clauses to convey a nuanced meaning.
options: Although he was tired, the children's excitement made him stay up late to watch the movie.
Although he was tired, the children's excitement made him staying up late to watch the movie.
Although he was tired, the children's excitement made him stay up late to watch the movie.
Although he was tired, the children's excitement made him stay up late to watch the movie.
questions.answer: Although he was tired, the children's excitement made him stay up late to watch the movie.
